title: Enforce independent review and acceptance evidence for PR workflows
objective: Add auditable ticket-linked controls for source-ticket linkage, per-commit cumulative-diff review evidence, independent reviewer identity/approval, and explicit owner acceptance gates before merge; separate follow-up, not part of PR #20.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every implementation PR is linked to an active ticket and each commit records its exact diff identity, required tests and independent review disposition; missing or stale evidence blocks merge.

Review evidence identifies an actually invoked independent reviewer, reviewed base/head/diff digest, findings, severity, disposition and unresolved blockers; self-review or test success cannot satisfy the gate.
PR acceptance criteria map to ticket evidence with distinct CI, runtime, synthetic and owner-observed evidence levels; owner-only gates require explicit owner approval before merge.

Enforcement is tested against missing-ticket, missing-review, stale-diff, self-approval, unresolved-blocker and absent-owner-acceptance cases; adoption does not alter historical ticket records or implement itself in PR #20.

needed: Define source of truth and event schema for commit/diff review identity and ticket linkage.
Test required/optional review policies and stale review invalidation after new commits.
Test owner-only acceptance gate and audit evidence across PR merge-check integration.
Record migration/adoption policy separately from PR #20.

Programmatically enforce the owner-mandated Luna High orchestration, delegated mechanical execution, documentation→tests→implementation→commit sequence, exact-SHA Sol review for every commit, ticket synchronization and clean handoff. Keep enforcement separate from PR #20 implementation.
cases: Related narrower deferred ticket #52 covers durable handoff sequencing; this ticket covers review/acceptance enforcement and is separate from PR #20.

Owner mandate for PR #20 and follow-on development: Luna High orchestrates/decides; delegate mechanical work/evidence/tests; every sub-phase tracked through ticket engine; docs→tests→implementation→commit; Sol reviews each exact commit SHA against cumulative PR/security/acceptance scope; correction commits get independent re-review; synchronize ticket/docs/evidence; never push or merge without approval. This procedural policy is to be applied manually now; programmatic enforcement remains this ticket's separate scope.

Superseding clarification: the 2026-11-15 temporary ticket-CLI comment exception is not used for this work. All ticket mutations, including comments, go through little-mester MCP tools; programmatic enforcement remains separate under #63.
